task_library.text: Photograph the nodular bedrock at the hollow edge
Note where smooth rock gives way to nodular rock
Locate the boxwork and sulfate unit contact
Brush dust from the bedrock at the contact
Photograph bedrock on each side of the contact
Analyse the bedrock just across the contact
Drill a sample from the hollow bedrock
Photograph the drill site before and after drilling
Compare the hollow bedrock with the ridge-top rock
